description: PreToolUse opens the dispatcher only for Bash and collaborationspawn_agent; every other hook event keeps one universal matcher into the manifest-shipped dispatcher .codex/pm_orch_codex.py --hook-dispatch, which decides in process which registered guards run for the payload. SubagentStart records matcher drift but never denies. Compaction hooks create a deduplicated checkpoint skeleton and re-inject the engine-owned PM snapshot without blocking compaction. Execpolicy remains argv-only and cannot enforce spawn metadata.

hooks.command:
if command -v python3 >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python3; elif command -v python >/dev/null 2>&1; then py=python; else py=; fi; fallback='{"systemMessage":"[hook-dispatch/warn] adapter-fallback: interpreter or dispatcher unavailable; PreToolUse guards skipped fail-open.","suppressOutput":false}'; if [ -z "$py" ]; then printf '%s
' "$fallback"; else out=$("$py" .codex/pm_orch_codex.py --hook-dispatch PreToolUse); rc=$?; if [ "$rc" -eq 0 ] && [ -n "$out" ]; then printf '%s
' "$out"; else printf '%s
' "$fallback"; fi; fi
hooks.commandWindows: $py = $null; foreach ($cand in @('py','python3','python')) { if (Get-Command $cand -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) { $probe = & $cand -c 'import sys; sys.stdout.write(str(sys.version_info >= (3, 11)))' 2> $null; if ($probe -eq 'True') { $py = $cand; break } } }; $fallback = '{"systemMessage":"[hook-dispatch/warn] adapter-fallback: interpreter or dispatcher unavailable; PreToolUse guards skipped fail-open.","suppressOutput":false}'; if ($null -eq $py) { Write-Output $fallback } else { $out = & $py '.codex/pm_orch_codex.py' --hook-dispatch PreToolUse; if ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0 -and $null -ne $out -and @($out).Count -gt 0) { Write-Output $out } else { Write-Output $fallback } }
